claims.text: McDonald is indexed in the Condon Report at pages 927 and 928, and separately for his part in Case 50 (657-662), Case 52 (683-684, 690, 692), his views on future research (1269), the northeast power outage (167) and the extraterrestrial hypothesis (34). He is the most heavily indexed outside critic in the study that was meant to close the question.

The Condon Report's index carries the entry 'Low, Robert J., 915-917', with subheadings 'appointed to Colorado project, viii' and 'quoted on Fuller article, 915' — the report itself indexes the controversy over Low's role.
